Penumbra and the Castle of Shadows - Enhanced 1.0.11:

The 2010 action platformer by André Santee, enhanced for today's computers and phones. Be the wizard: grab your sword, throw fireballs, light up the dark and defeat the king who rules the castle. Play alone, with a friend, or against each other in Versus.

New in 1.0.11:

This update is about phones whose Android is 32-bit. Everything else plays as in 1.0.10, which stays available.

• What was tried, and what was not. On an Android 11 emulator that can only run 32-bit apps (it translates ARM programs so that a PC can run them), 1.0.10 was refused as having no program that fits, and 1.0.11 installed, started and played level 1. No real 32-bit phone has run it: an emulator on a PC is not a phone's processor or graphics chip, so how fast it runs there is unknown. That the phone that reported the problem runs a 32-bit Android has not been confirmed by the player (we asked for the phone's details); it comes from other owners of the same model. If it is the Infinix Smart 9 (the Smart 9 HD has a different chip), its graphics chip is the same kind as the Galaxy A05's, so its picture may be soft, as described in 1.0.10; the "Picture sharpness" row on the Settings screen is there for that.

How far each download has been checked:

• Mac: It was tested automatically on GitHub's Macs and its Intel half under Rosetta. Nobody has played it on a real Mac, and it is not notarised by Apple.
• iPhone and iPad: experimental. It has never run on any iPhone or iPad, so it may not start.
• Languages: eleven, switchable in the game. The translations were made with AI help and have not been checked by native speakers.
• Free. No ads, no in-app purchases, no accounts. The game never connects to the internet.

Checksums (SHA256SUMS.txt):

Every file is built from commit 5fef6d7568602cfd14db5eb9fea80c7fdff9dbab.

Credits:

Original game (2010): André Santee (programming, game design, Ethanon Engine), Arthur Santee (3D modelling, game design), Gabriel Duarte (soundtrack), Approaching Thunderstorm (music). Enhanced edition: Ivan Cvetanović, developed with Claude Code, on the Supersonic Engine. Touch buttons, the options screen's frames, buttons and icons, and the touch-controls editor's buttons: from Magic Rampage, by Asantee Games.

Free; the source code is on GitHub. Provided as is, without any warranty; see LICENSE.md.

Penumbra and the Castle of Shadows - Enhanced 1.0.11 (Português):

O jogo de plataforma e ação de 2010 de André Santee, aprimorado para os computadores e celulares de hoje. Seja o mago: pegue a espada, lance bolas de fogo, ilumine a escuridão e derrote o rei que domina o castelo. Jogue sozinho, com um amigo, ou um contra o outro no modo Versus.

Novidades da 1.0.11:

Esta atualização trata de celulares cujo Android é de 32 bits. O resto joga como na 1.0.10, que continua disponível.

• O que foi testado e o que não foi. Num emulador de Android 11 que só roda apps de 32 bits (ele traduz programas ARM para que um PC possa rodá-los), a 1.0.10 foi recusada por não ter nenhum programa compatível, e a 1.0.11 se instalou, abriu e rodou a fase 1. Nenhum celular de 32 bits de verdade rodou isto: um emulador num PC não é o processador nem o chip gráfico de um celular, então não sabemos qual é a velocidade num celular. Que o celular que relatou o problema rode um Android de 32 bits ainda não foi confirmado pelo jogador (pedimos os dados do celular); vem de outros donos do mesmo modelo. Se for o Infinix Smart 9 (o Smart 9 HD tem outro chip), o chip gráfico dele é do mesmo tipo que o do Galaxy A05, então a imagem pode ficar pouco nítida, como descrito na 1.0.10; a linha "Nitidez da imagem" na tela de configurações existe para isso.

Até onde cada download foi verificado:

• Android: o jogo foi jogado do começo ao fim num celular de verdade por quem o criou, inclusive a tela que ajusta os botões (uma versão anterior). O que é novo na 1.0.11 é o programa de 32 bits, testado só no emulador descrito
